data.name: Description
data.value: View and manage local images, camera resources, and cache storage.

data.name: Protected
data.value: Cleanup uses category-specific file lists. Active and protected files are retained.

data.name: ScanFirst
data.value: Scan first, then review the files to clean.

data.name: LogsDescription
data.value: Only historical application logs; active log files are kept.

data.name: TemporaryDescription
data.value: Expired update staging files, diagnostic archives and feedback screenshots; excludes other apps.

data.name: PackagesDescription
data.value: Old application and plugin packages; pending updates and resumable downloads are kept.

data.name: CieDescription
data.value: Rebuildable CIE backgrounds, not calibration files or business images.

data.name: ThumbnailsDescription
data.value: Clears thumbnail previews and their index. Rebuilt when images are browsed again.

data.name: ScanComplete
data.value: Scan complete. Select categories and review their file lists.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: Cancelled. Files already deleted are not restored.

data.name: ConfirmClean
data.value: Permanently delete {0} scanned items, approximately {1}? Files in use or changed after scanning will be skipped.

data.name: DatabaseDescription
data.value: Choose the data source, retention and backup separately; never included in storage cleanup.

data.name: SnapshotsDescription
data.value: View, create and manage application recovery snapshots; excluded from cache cleanup.

data.name: ConfigBackupDescription
data.value: Back up the entire settings file, including sections not loaded in this session.

data.name: ResetDescription
data.value: Reset only the selected app settings at the next startup, after a successful backup. Device settings, database connections, licences and business data are preserved.

data.name: ResetConfirm
data.value: Reset: {0}. You can cancel before closing. Save your work and restart normally. Schedule this reset?

data.name: ResetScheduled
data.value: Reset scheduled for the next startup. Save your work, then restart normally.

data.name: AdminRequired
data.value: This action requires an application administrator.

data.name: SelectReset
data.value: Select at least one setting to reset.

data.name: NoFiles
data.value: No files match the current cleanup rules.

data.name: BusyClose
data.value: Scanning or cleanup is still running. Cancel or wait before closing the window.

data.name: CacheUnavailable
data.value: The cache does not exist or has no removable entries.

data.name: ThumbnailList
data.value: Thumbnails are cleared through the cache manager. Original images are never deleted.

data.name: StoppedForSafety
data.value: This category is protected while related tasks are active.

data.name: FlowBusy
data.value: Stop inspection or acquisition and confirm no other writers are using the database before maintenance.

data.name: ResetApplied
data.value: Settings reset applied. Full configuration backup: {0}

data.name: ResetDeferred
data.value: Reset was deferred because another ColorVision instance is running. Save your work, close all instances, then start again.

data.name: UpdateTemporaryProtected
data.value: Temporary update files are protected while an update is running or awaiting installation.

data.name: FeedbackProtected
data.value: The feedback window is using diagnostic packages and screenshots. These attachments are protected.

data.name: UpdatePackagesProtected
data.value: All installer packages are protected while an update is running or awaiting installation.

data.name: ResetStartupFailed
data.value: The last startup could not finish the reset: {0}. You can cancel the plan and inspect the configuration and backup.

data.name: FileManagementDescription
data.value: Review files, choose retention, and confirm cleanup. Maintain configuration and calibration resources in their resource manager.

data.name: MemoryManagementDescription
data.value: Inspect camera, calibration and image buffers, and release idle memory.

data.name: AccessDenied
data.value: The current user or policy does not allow this operation.

data.name: ConfigurationDescription
data.value: Manage settings backups, reset and recovery, and crash dump configuration.

data.name: StorageScope
data.value: Manage images, camera resources, and caches on this computer. Remote database servers are excluded.

data.name: UsagePartial
data.value: Partial results; {0} locations could not be fully read.

data.name: UsageCancelled
data.value: Scan cancelled. Completed categories remain available.

data.name: UsageManifestMissing
data.value: No file manifest was provided; this usage is excluded from the total.

data.name: ReadOnlyResources
data.value: Configuration and calibration resources are read-only here. Use the resource manager to modify them.

data.name: CategoryUnavailable
data.value: This category is unavailable. Refresh the file management list.
